question: In which direction is the general elevation of the peninsular plateau of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**From West to East**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The general elevation of the peninsular plateau** of India is from **West to East**.
 
• This elevation pattern is due to the geological history and the tectonic movements that have shaped the region.
